summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. Added per-material pricing endpoints (PATCH/DELETE) and Takeoff PDF tests. All 17 new tests + 22 regression tests pass (39/39, 100%). AI pipeline correctly produces unit_price (USD) for materials, validation/auth rules work, PDF endpoint returns valid application/pdf with correct Content-Disposition.

minor.issue: Negative quantity is silently clamped to 0 but spec only mentions clamping unit_price. Either ok or document the behavior.
Sending only name='   ' (whitespace) results in 400 'Nothing to update' because name.strip() is empty - behavior is reasonable but could be clearer (return validation error instead).
Cross-user returns 404 (per spec). Note: list_projects/materials etc. also return 404 for cross-user, consistent.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~810 lines — approaching the 700-line guidance. Consider splitting into modules (auth/, projects/, documents/, pdf/) as the codebase grows.
Takeoff PDF imports (reportlab) happen inside the request handler. Functionally fine but moving them to module-level imports would slightly reduce per-request latency.

MaterialPatchIn does not enforce min_length for name (only stripped); empty/whitespace-only names silently fall through to the 'nothing to update' path. Acceptable but worth a unit-level Pydantic validator.

Cross-user access on PATCH/DELETE returns 403 (material exists, project doesn't belong) while cross-user GET on /takeoff.pdf returns 404. Slight inconsistency in info-leak posture but matches existing project endpoints.
AI pricing depends on GPT-4o; pipeline still inserts materials with unit_price=0 if model omits price. Test confirms >=50% get prices in practice.
test_credentials: Tests use freshly-registered users (test_a_*/test_b_*@example.com, password TestPass123!) per session via conftest fixtures.
seed_data_creation: Each test session creates 2 users (User A, User B) and uploads a PIL-generated floor_plan.png; analyzed_project module fixture creates one extra project + materials via the real GPT-4o pipeline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/conftest.py for fixtures (base_url, user_a/b, floor_plan_png, auth_headers_a/b). test_pricing_pdf.py owns iteration-2 features (PATCH/DELETE/PDF). For PDF, validate headers + magic bytes (%PDF), don't parse content. AI pipeline takes ~10-20s per upload; fixtures already wait up to 120s.
